name: How can I tell if a flooring material is truly non-slip?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if a flooring material is truly non-slip?

acceptedAnswer.text: To assess if a flooring material is truly non-slip, look for its coefficient of friction (COF) rating, though residential products don't always publish this. A higher COF generally indicates better slip resistance. You can also inspect the surface for texture; materials with a slightly rough or embossed finish will offer more grip than smooth, polished surfaces. Consider how the material performs when wet, as this is a critical factor in kitchen environments. Reputable manufacturers often highlight non-slip properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for COF ratings or inspect the surface for texture to determine if a flooring material is truly non-slip.
